start.observation: An ordinary center-screen tap starts active flight directly from the obstacle-free waiting scene.

agency.normalInput: Repeated center-screen taps at the flight cadence.
agency.controlCondition: The same-duration run with zero input.
agency.observation: The tapped run repeatedly changed the saucer's vertical velocity and advanced through the gate corridor, while the zero-input run did not reproduce that flight path.

restart.observation: A collision reached the stable end state; an ordinary tap returned to ready, and the next tap launched a second playable run.

start.observation: The finished game opens directly on the flight scene with only BEST visible and no gates. One ordinary center-screen tap fades BEST out, reveals the run score, creates the gate field, and launches the saucer.

agency.normalInput: Repeated center-screen taps at the flight cadence.
agency.controlCondition: The same-duration final build with zero input.
agency.observation: All three supported-surface controls remained obstacle-free with score zero, while their matched tap tapes showed visible tap-driven flight and approaching gates.

restart.observation: The final build reached a collision, accepted an ordinary restart tap, returned to the obstacle-free waiting scene, and launched a second playable run without a pause control.
